item.title: String of robberies in South Philadelphia prompts police warning
item.description: Police are alerting South Philadelphia residents after a series of five robberies since mid-January, with officers distributing flyers and neighbors expressing concern about safety.Police detail recent robberies and suspect descriptionsPolice say the first robbery happened Jan. 17 at 1:45 a.m. on the 900 block of Washington Avenue, when three men pushed a person off an e-bike and took it. item.description: Hundreds of protesters gathered along the Whitehorse Pike outside the Lindenwold Municipal Building on Friday, expressing outrage after federal immigration officers were reportedly seen near a local apartment complex where children were waiting for their school bus.Community reacts to ICE presence near school bus stopThe Lindenwold School District said agents with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement were seen Thursday morning at the Woodland Village Apartment Complex. item.title: Man shot and killed after altercation outside Philadelphia bar on 54th Street
item.description: Police say a man was shot multiple times after an altercation outside a Philadelphia bar on 54th Street just after 2 a.m. He later died at the hospital.

item.title: Man killed in West Philadelphia highway shooting; 2 others injured in separate violent incidents
item.description: One man is dead and two others were injured in three separate violent incidents across Philadelphia early Saturday, police say.

item.title: Flooding at Callowhill parking garage leaves cars in standing water in Philadelphia
item.description: Cars are sitting in standing water inside the 1601 Callowhill St. parking garage in Philadelphia as flooding continues despite crews on scene.

item.title: Pennsbury High School lockdown lifted after threat deemed 'not credible': Police
item.description: Pennsbury High School in Bucks County reopened after police determined an online threat was not credible. The campus had been placed on lockdown earlier in the morning.

item.title: Man shot dead while sitting inside car on Philadelphia street corner

item.title: 9-year-old boy hospitalized after hit-and-run in West Philadelphia
item.description: Philadelphia police are looking for a driver they say hit a young boy in broad daylight, then drove off, leaving him injured.A 9-year-old was struck by a vehicle on the 800 block of 56th Street around 12:22 p.m. Saturday.Police say the driver fled the scene in his vehicle.The boy was transported to CHOP with various injuries, and is said to be in stable condition.The driver has yet to be identified or found. item.title: Police seek man who robbed, dragged elderly woman at Northeast Philadelphia bus stop
item.description: Police are searching for a man accused of robbing and dragging an elderly woman using a crutch as she waited for a bus in Northeast Philadelphia earlier this month.
